summary: Installation-wide assistant PAUSE table (cinatra#1880, Epic #1873 W5) — the operator-upgrade twin of the fresh-install bootstrap DDL (assistantPauseSchemaQueries in src/lib/assistant-registry-schema.ts, spread into buildCreateStoreSchemaQueries). ONE brand-new table assistant_pause keyed by the assistant PRINCIPAL (assistant_user_id PK — the SAME axis the W2 builtin-host fix f9f70d26a keys on, so a handle/alias rename never loses or retargets a pause): presence of a row == the assistant is paused; a paused principal drops out of the audience-filtered registry reader (readAssistantRegistryForActor) exactly like an out-of-audience one, so pause is enforced fail-closed across every W2 surface (browser routing, MCP entry/continuation, widget broker) through the ONE audience truth. The builtin Cinatra principal is never paused (the reader unions it in unconditionally; the writer + UI refuse it). Rides the idempotent bootstrap DDL (same PR); this module carries the same CREATE onto the operator upgrade path — pure CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, a no-op on a bootstrap-seeded schema, ledger-faked on a fresh install, and no pre-existing row is touched (an empty table == nothing paused). Single all-or-nothing transaction; unqualified names resolve to the app schema on the runner's search_path. down() drops the table (true reverse; pause rows lost by design as a structural addition, not a rename). SEQ RECONCILED: cut against core__0068 (#1875 W2) as provisional 0069; a sibling W3 lane landed core__0069_assistant-thread-title-slug on origin/main first, moving this slice to 0070; then core__0071_unbound-output-derivation-outbox (#1893) and core__0072_artifact-review-gate-store (#1796) shipped on origin/main, and core__0075_widget-auth-token-keys-canonical then landed on origin/main, making 0075 the max shipped seq, so on the rebase onto main this slice was renumbered to the next genuinely-free sequence 0076 (rename-only, zero SQL diff — the additive CREATE TABLE is seq-agnostic). migrations/** is HIGH-RISK: owner approval required; the lane never merges. destructive=false (brand-new table, no user-land data affected).
